decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The permission hereby granted shall be for a limited period expiring three years from the date of the decision notice when the use shall cease.

Condition : 4 - Suites 1, 3, 5, 12 and 15 of the premises shall be used for education and for no other purpose (including any other purpose in Class D1 of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification).
Condition : 5 - No fans, louvres, ducts or other external plant shall be installed without the prior approval of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 6 - The use hereby permitted for education (D1) purposes shall not be carried on outside the following times: 09.00 - 18.00 Monday - Friday.
description: Change of use of suites 1, 3, 5, 12 and 15 from offices (B1a) to educational (D1) for a period of 3 years
